name: Tsukibane Ai
source:
The daughter of the president of a large enterprise, and Haruki's childhood friend. 

A cool beauty whose grades and figure are top class. She speaks very little, and often doesn't show any expression. In actuality, she's incredibly shy.

[Taken from [url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/a-butterfly-in-the-district-of-dreams/]Sekai Project[/url]]
